cases.title: Add new bookmark into a specific location
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark can be successfully added into a specific designated location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Delete bookmark from bookmarks file
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark is properly deleted from the bookmarks file.

cases.title: Remove bookmark display from all access points
cases.description: Verify that a deleted bookmark is no longer displayed from all access points.

cases.title: Add bookmark to personal toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark is successfully added to the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Delete bookmark from personal toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark is successfully deleted from the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Insert new bookmark folder into bookmarks hierarchy
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark folder can be successfully inserted into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Launch bookmark in browser window
cases.description: Verify that double-clicking on a bookmark causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Validate default bookmarks packaged with browser
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks within the default bookmarks file that is packaged with the browser are valid links.

cases.title: Verify bookmark item changes are saved without loss of integrity
cases.description: Verify that changes made to a bookmark item are successfully saved without any loss of item integrity.

cases.title: Delete Bookmarks Folder
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks folder can be successfully deleted.

cases.title: Add bookmarks separator
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks separator can be successfully added.

cases.title: Delete bookmarks separator
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks separator can be successfully deleted.

cases.title: Save Bookmark Changes Over Restart
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks changes are successfully saved and persisted when the browser is restarted.

cases.title: Save Bookmark Changes Over Crash
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks changes are successfully saved and persisted following a browser crash.

cases.title: View properties execution for bookmarks, folders, and separators negative test
cases.description: Verify that view properties execution fails or is not possible negatively for bookmarks, folders, and separators.

cases.title: Inline renaming of bookmarks without properties dialog
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be renamed inline directly without having to use the bookmarks properties dialog.

cases.title: Find Bookmark Using User-Defined Custom Keyword
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be found using a user-defined custom keyword.

cases.title: Sort bookmarks per column
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are sorted per column.

cases.title: Reverse-sort bookmarks per column
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be resized to show or hide more of the entries.

cases.title: Show bookmark columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be explicitly shown.

cases.title: Hide bookmark columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be explicitly hidden.

cases.title: Delete multiple bookmarks at one time
cases.description: Verify that several bookmarks can be successfully deleted at the same time.

cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark item onto itself
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto itself.

cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark item onto its immediate parent
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto its immediate parent.

cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark item onto its immediate child
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto its immediate child.

opinions.feedback: The proposed test cases cover the functional requirements well, but there are instances of redundant cases splitting a single requirement into separate tests where a single integrated test case would suffice (e.g., R-002 split into G-002 and G-003, R-014 split into G-018 and G-019, R-016 split into G-021 and G-022, and R-018 split into G-024, G-025, and G-026). These can be combined to maintain clean test coverage without losing any verification scope.
All requirements and test cases align correctly with the functional specifications.

R-010: Multiple distinct behaviors (save over restart, save over crash). R-011: Single straightforward acceptance criterion with negative test indication. R-012: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. R-013: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. R-014: Multiple distinct behaviors (sort per column, reverse-sort per column). R-015: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. R-016: Multiple distinct behaviors (column show, column hide). R-017: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. R-018: Multiple distinct behaviors (drop onto itself, drop onto immediate parent, drop onto immediate child).
